description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "create", "edit", "specialize", "review / remediate", "write the rationale for", "translate / localise", or "fix the ADL syntax of" an openEHR archetype (including "this archetype won't parse / won't validate"), or to import a CKM archetype into the workspace for reuse. It covers the full author → review (lint → fix → re-lint) → rationale → translate lifecycle. To merely explain an existing archetype with no edits, use `/openehr-explain` instead.
